cells.gaps: Nothing found since October 2023 says a Togolese e-procurement system is procured, being built, piloted or in service; in October 2026 ARCOP was still recruiting consultants to prepare one.
cells.note: TGO-001 is a workshop on the e-GP strategy and TGO-002 a call for consultants to help prepare the future system; neither is a system procured, built or piloted, so no rung is set.
